title: mime-tree: lib.rs has no crate-level documentation — docs.rs shows nothing
description: mime-tree/src/lib.rs has only a one-line comment and module declarations; no //\! crate-level doc comment with usage example. Consequence: docs.rs shows only the terse comment 'RFC 5322 / MIME parser producing a byte-range-indexed part tree' with no example of how to call parse() and access the result.
